column1: # comment: "Universal identity/coreference alignments. GMEOW links entities to authority records by reference (authorityLink + SKOS match strength) and avoids owl:sameAs merge semantics for contested or standpoint-indexed claims."

column6: schema:sameAs is a projection target for exact authority links; GMEOW's canonical data keeps authorityLink plus explicit skos:exactMatch/closeMatch strength.

both relate a local description to a close external authority record, by reference (PROV activity alignment phase 2). mads:authoritativeLabel is REFUSED: GMEOW has no authority-control labeling model — skos:prefLabel serves that role.
PROV alternateOf captures alternate entities presenting aspects of the same thing, without owl:sameAs identity collapse.
An edition is a work-version relation for Dublin Core consumers; GMEOW keeps editionOf distinct from generic versionOf.
